ideas.title: Minnesota fraud cases on the rise
ideas.description: Investigating the recent surge in fraud cases in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future scheme and Medicaid fraud scheme.
ideas.angle: Analyzing the causes and consequences of these fraud cases
questions: What are the common factors among these fraud cases?
How can these cases be prevented in the future?
ideas.insight: The recent sentencing of Aimee Bock and subpoena of Hasan Piker suggest increased scrutiny of individuals and organizations involved in fraud schemes.
